summary_en: Final dividend for FY5/26 raised to 15 yen/share (10 yen ordinary + 5 yen 30th-anniversary special) from prior forecast of 10 yen/share. Upward earnings revision drove the 5 yen/share increase. Board resolution passed; subject to AGM approval on August 27, 2026.
title_en: Notice regarding revision of dividend forecast (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief: Media Five (ticker 3824) announced on July 9, 2026 that its board has approved an upward revision to the final dividend forecast for fiscal year ending May 2026. The final dividend is being increased by 5 yen per share, from the prior forecast of 10 yen/share to 15 yen/share. The revised dividend comprises 10 yen/share of ordinary dividend and 5 yen/share of special 30th-anniversary commemorative dividend. The company attributed the increase to full-year earnings results exceeding the previously published guidance, combined with its policy of maintaining stable and continuous profit distribution to shareholders while preserving sufficient internal reserves for business growth. The resolution requires approval at the ordinary general meeting of shareholders scheduled for August 27, 2026.
